name: Grimeton Radio Station, Varberg
description: Near Varberg on Sweden's west coast, Grimeton Radio Station was built in 1922–24 to send telegraph messages across the Atlantic to North America. Six steel towers, each 127 metres tall, still carry its aerial wires above the fields. Inside is the last working Alexanderson alternator, a pre-electronic transmitter that is still fired up for Morse code broadcasts on Alexanderson Day each year.
